name: @w6w-apps/fareharbor
description: Read FareHarbor companies, items and availability, and validate, create, cancel and check in bookings over the External API.

w6w.longDescription:
FareHarbor is booking and reservation software for tour and activity operators. This app lets a workflow work with the External API that FareHarbor issues to approved integration partners: list the companies your keys may book, read their items (bookable products), pull availability for a date or a date range, and read bookings by availability, by creation date or by UUID.

It can also write: validate a booking before creating it, create one (with transportation, rebooking and custom fields), update a booking's note, check customers in, cancel a booking and re-send confirmation emails.

Authentication is FareHarbor's two keys, an App key and a User key; the User key is tied to one currency, so use one connection per currency. FareHarbor limits requests per IP address (30 a second and 3,000 per 5 minutes) and times availability ranges out at 60 seconds, so pull availability in short ranges. Only the production API is supported, not the demo sandbox.
